title: Catalogue .progress as a documented component with an a11y contract

review.applied: alias trim (req 1), aria-valuetext added to a11y (req 2), convergence criterion rewritten to the verified mapping (req 3)

problem: Downstream agents (3 independent runs) needed determinate progress for a long-running job and rebuilt the same composition from scratch under fallback/plain-content; the .progress primitive ships in core/base.css and is demoed in the docs, but is unciteable (no spec entry, no a11y contract, no aliases).
evidence: baseline resolves: 3x FALLBACK(plain-content), 3x UNDEFINED, 1x stray COMPOSE for progress phrasings; search 'progress' yields only pattern/index-eval + component/spinner (docs/evolution/data/baseline-resolves-0.12.1.json)
existing_authority_considered: component/badge + recipe/status-with-text - state labels; compose, but not a meter
pattern/index-eval, pattern/dashboard - placements, not the unit
why_insufficient: The CSS primitive exists (core/base.css:179-180, .progress + .progress i + --dur-progress) and is demonstrated in examples, but has no states/verify contract, no documented a11y semantics (role/aria-valuenow/aria-valuetext), and no vocabulary; every run had to re-derive it as an improvisation.

triage_snapshot: spec/states.json: add component { class: 'progress', name: 'Progress bar', source: 'base.css', status: 'beta', states: ['determinate (aria-valuenow)','complete (100%)'], verify: ['.progress','.progress i'], a11y: [role=progressbar with aria-valuemin/max/now on the track; aria-valuetext carries the human readout (e.g. '12 of 40 scanned') and the adjacent visible text is the same words; never colour alone; width transitions use --dur-progress; completion announced via toast/banner] }
site/pages_components.py: the existing .progress demo gains role=progressbar + aria-valuenow attributes in the demo markup.
VERSION bump + CHANGELOG entry (shared with cand/01).
curation: aliases.json: component/progress -> ['progress bar','progress meter','progress track'] (dropped 'determinate progress' - with it, baseline phrasings #3/#4/#6 resolved to the bare component instead of the recipe)
component-notes.json: component/progress summary ('Determinate progress bar; compose with badge + text readout via recipe/job-progress; indeterminate waits use component/spinner')
docs-map.json: component/progress -> the components page section that demos it

not_proposed: component/progress as a new build (c3 proposal) - nothing new to build; DOWNGRADE to documentation
component/job-progress (c1 proposal) - composite worth a recipe, not a primitive; DOWNGRADE
compatibility: Additive: no CSS changes at all; only a spec entry + docs attributes + vocabulary. Zero breakage risk.

validation.g02_mapping: 5 x COMPOSE recipe/job-progress (#1,#3,#4,#6,#7) + 2 x RESOLVED component/progress (#2 '...live progress readout', #5 'Progress bar ... stalled state'); zero FALLBACK / UNDEFINED / stray COMPOSE
validation.why_component_level: #2/#5 name the bar itself; routing them to the recipe would require contorting component docs - not recommended (review note)
validation.triage_gates: build.py check (states matrix at 37 components, verify selector pass), strict lint
validation.non_regression: spinner/status phrasings unchanged; delete battery unaffected

migration: Existing .progress compositions become sanctioned when they cite component/progress + recipe/job-progress; no markup change required for the bar itself.
